from fastapi import APIRouter, status
import uuid

from .models import Run, RunCreate, ParticipantIn
from .store import run_store
from .errors import ApiError

router = APIRouter()


def _find_run(run_id: str) -> Run:
    run = run_store.get(run_id)
    if run is None:
        raise ApiError("run_not_found", f"Run '{run_id}' not found")
    return run


@router.post("/runs", response_model=Run, status_code=status.HTTP_201_CREATED)
def post_runs(payload: RunCreate):
    if not payload.title or not payload.title.strip():
        raise ApiError("validation_error", "title is required and cannot be empty")
    if not payload.datetime or not payload.datetime.strip():
        raise ApiError("validation_error", "datetime is required and cannot be empty")
    if not payload.meeting_location or not payload.meeting_location.strip():
        raise ApiError("validation_error", "meeting_location is required and cannot be empty")

    run_id = uuid.uuid4().hex[:12]

    run = Run(
        id=run_id,
        title=payload.title,
        datetime=payload.datetime,
        meeting_location=payload.meeting_location,
        distance=payload.distance,
        pace_target=payload.pace_target,
        route_notes=payload.route_notes,
        capacity=payload.capacity,
        participants=[],
        participant_count=0,
    )
    run_store[run_id] = run
    return run


@router.get("/runs", response_model=list[Run])
def get_runs():
    return list(run_store.values())


@router.get("/runs/{run_id}", response_model=Run)
def get_runs_run_id(run_id: str):
    return _find_run(run_id)


@router.post("/runs/{run_id}/join", response_model=Run, status_code=200)
def post_runs_run_id_join(run_id: str, payload: ParticipantIn):
    run = _find_run(run_id)

    name = payload.name
    if not name or not name.strip():
        raise ApiError("validation_error", "Participant name cannot be empty")

    for existing in run.participants:
        if existing.lower() == name.strip().lower():
            raise ApiError("duplicate_participant", f"Participant '{name}' is already joined to this run")

    run.participants.append(name)
    run.participant_count = len(run.participants)
    return run


@router.post("/runs/{run_id}/leave", response_model=Run, status_code=200)
def post_runs_run_id_leave(run_id: str, payload: ParticipantIn):
    run = _find_run(run_id)

    name = payload.name
    if not name or not name.strip():
        raise ApiError("validation_error", "Participant name cannot be empty")

    for i, existing in enumerate(run.participants):
        if existing.lower() == name.strip().lower():
            run.participants.pop(i)
            run.participant_count = len(run.participants)
            return run

    raise ApiError("participant_not_found", f"Participant '{name}' not found on this run")
